title: Consideration for using Foundation Model
description: Foundation models are powerful tools, but there are definitely some things to consider before diving in. Here are some key areas to think about - Bias, Data quality, Data poison, Explainability, Transparency, Misinformation

title: "Unleashing Creativity with Generative AI: A Comprehensive Guide"
description: Generative AI, a subset of artificial intelligence, uses machine learning techniques to produce content such as text, images, music, and more, with GPT-3 by OpenAI being a notable example. While these models can yield impressive results, they also pose ethical and practical considerations, including potential misuse for creating deepfakes or generating misleading content, and the need for diverse, representative training data to avoid bias.
